environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL with the following rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING override to COUNT, (2) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet in default BLOCK action, (3) a custom rate-based rule at 100 requests per 5 minutes per IP. Additionally, the ECS task role has an IAM permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/DenyNetworkEgress) that denies ec2:*, s3:*, and all network-related actions preventing data exfiltration via out-of-band channels. The task runs in a private subnet with no NAT gateway or internet gateway route, egress only to VPC endpoints for ECR and CloudWatch Logs.

config.network: Private subnet, no IGW/NAT, VPC endpoints only for ecr.dkr, ecr.api, logs
config.egress: No internet egress, DNS resolves only VPC endpoint addresses
